intersections.rule: Servers is grouped by where the agent runs (This phone / My computers / Outside agents). Connect owns the list, switching and adding a computer. Install owns anything that puts software on a host: the This phone row hands off to phone setup v2, and phone-setup-ready hands back with "Switch to this phone". Adding a computer never installs; host-management becomes a sheet from server-settings.

New conversation owns the start; Team is a mode of it (Solo · Team, remembered per server). A team task is a chat-page conversation whose workers are sub-agents. The team page is overview and configuration, never where work starts or is followed. Every "give a task" and "open a task" door ends in team-conversation.
The request card in the conversation owns the answer. Sheets open only from the card's Details, for a full diff or a long form, and return to the card with a receipt.

Observe surfaces point, they do not answer. Inbox rows, Work's Needs you line, notifications and other-server rows open the conversation scrolled to the card (switching server first with a confirm). A notification quick action may send the one-tap answer through the same request model.

Team gates are request cards in the task conversation, built from the same KitRequestCard and KitReceipt as chat. The team home's Needs you lists and links, and the supervision level decides which gates reach the person at all.

Inbox owns "what needs me and what finished" on every server. Work owns "what I am working on" (running, recent, team tasks as conversations). Server rows carry a status word. attention-overview is deleted and profile-monitor folds into the Servers rows and the Notifications setting.

Delegate owns discovery (Solo · Team, team-intro, automatic discovery). Install owns putting the team on the phone (the v2 aiteam component). Connect owns pointing at a computer's team (team-host-sheet). Every path hands back to team-conversation with "Give the team a first task".
Approve owns the decision; review supplies a read-only KitDiffView opened from it and returns to the decision.
Undo from a prompt is a review action with one flow. Recover surfaces (failed runs, errors) link to it and never build their own revert.
The conversation owns its queued messages and drafts (one bubble, undo-first). Inbox does not list the offline queue. The connection status line is shared chrome read from one source.
Work owns running conversations. The host-neutral "Running on this phone" tool owns processes, including dev services and the team. The Project tab owns dev commands and the terminal.
Changes made inside a conversation apply to that conversation; Settings sets defaults. Both open the same component (model sheet, approvals sheet, display switches).
Connect owns sign-in (Providers). Account owns the numbers (the Usage hub: Spent and Remaining). agent-account becomes the Codex quota source plus its sign-in state.
The error state owns the moment and offers "Report a problem", which opens diagnostics prefilled with that error. Settings and About are secondary doors to the same flow.
The phone's own server is configured on the This phone page; server-settings for that server links there. Configuration changes that need software run as v2 jobs.
The worker's conversation (watching mode) owns "what is it doing"; the raw output is its fallback rendering, never a separate door.

bootstrap-gate then root-connecting (two waiting screens); team Now line vs cycle strip vs team-cycle-how-sheet

priorities.title: Answer the agent in one place with one card
priorities.why: This is the remote-lead's core job, and it is also the one that is least consistent. The same request lands in chat from Work but in a sheet from the Inbox. Answers come in three card shapes. Team gates have receipts and chat answers do not. The work line says "Running tools" while the agent waits.

priorities.title: Make a team task one page: every door opens the task conversation, which can stop the task
priorities.why: Team-home rows and notifications open RunScreen: onOpenRun is never passed (team_home_screen.dart:132-143) and the notification link goes to RunScreen at main.dart:967. "Give the team a task" from the home stays on the home. The conversation has no Stop. The routing fix is small: pass TeamConversation.open and call TeamConversation.start. Folding RunScreen into Task details is medium.

priorities.title: Unify all installation into phone setup v2 (OpenCode, Claude Code, AI Team; in-app or Termux host)
priorities.why: The owner's repeated note is "Align with v2". Today there are three installers, four progress surfaces and two success moments. 17 ledger edges still reach the old Termux wizard. Claude Code cannot be added from Add tools.

priorities.title: Make the Inbox the only "needs me" list; delete attention-overview; fold profile-monitor into server rows
priorities.why: Four pages answer "which other server needs me" with three behaviours, one of them on a stale cache. Two tabs duplicate the same requests. The owner offered deleting attention-overview.

priorities.title: Use one connection status and a diagnosed failure view
priorities.why: The most frequent failure on a phone that shares a server with Termux or proot. Today it has two implementations, three wordings, a raw-error sheet and three restart confirms. The phone-only persona needs "stopped / paused for heat" told apart from "offline".

priorities.title: Report a problem from any error, with diagnostics attached
priorities.why: Owner note: "a first grade page that users willingly use to raise bugs … accessible when errors happen". Today GitHub gets only the version, while diagnostics go to the person's own server log.

priorities.title: Turn the team on from one team page with automatic discovery
priorities.why: Five doors lead to three flows. Settings > AI Team opens Plugins when the team is on (search_index.dart:548). There is a third management sheet under an engine name.

priorities.title: Add a computer in one path (no double agent choice, inline address check, pairing-link sheet)
priorities.why: This is the newcomer's first real step. Servers has two Add buttons, the first run asks the agent kind twice, and a pairing link for an unknown server lands on a list.

priorities.title: Show queued messages as one bubble, and handle drafts and saved prompts undo-first
priorities.why: Principle 10 (never lose work) on flaky networks. The owner asked for one bubble with a clear CTA. There are three homes for unsent text, and confirmations appear where nothing can be lost.

priorities.title: Use one "Undo from here" flow and one diff component
priorities.why: Revert behaves differently by protocol, from different doors (chat_screen.dart:4689/4712). Two diff renderers mean a change looks different in the permission sheet, in review and in the team merge.

priorities.title: Add KitConfirmSheet and apply the undo-vs-confirm rule app-wide
priorities.why: The work is mechanical, but it removes the most visible inconsistency (the same act asks first on one door and undoes on another). It is the most requested kit gap in the map (78 elements).

priorities.title: Make watching a worker mean opening its conversation, and message it from the conversation composer
priorities.why: Whether you see a conversation or raw output depends on the door, not on the session. Three message places produce three receipts.

priorities.title: Redesign the command sheet with per-backend catalogs, and cut the session menu to Go to / Do
priorities.why: Owner Rethink: "we are out of the terminal … will this support Claude or Codex commands?" Today the Codex and Paseo catalogs are empty, and two menus duplicate each other.

priorities.title: Make voice a composer mode with automatic model setup and no 30-second cap
priorities.why: One-hand, away-from-desk use. Owner: "Why only 30 seconds, this needs rework". The model must be set up before the first use.

priorities.title: Start all work from New conversation (Solo · Team · separate copy), always ending in a conversation
priorities.why: Work starts work in three ways. Creating a separate copy lands in a conversation from one door and in a bare list from another.
